title: How Much Does Hardwood Floor Installation Cost in Lynnwood? 2026 Labor and Material Prices
meta: Hardwood floor installation in Lynnwood costs $3.25 per sq ft for labor at Wills Flooring, $2.75 unfinished. See what material adds and price your floor live.
keywords: hardwood floor installation cost Lynnwood, hardwood flooring installation price per square foot, engineered hardwood installation cost 2026, Lynnwood WA hardwood floors, cost to install hardwood floors labor and material
offers: Hardwood floor installation, engineered or solid

blocks.lead: In Lynnwood, hardwood floor installation labor costs $3.25 per sq ft for engineered or solid prefinished flooring, $2.75 per sq ft for unfinished, and $125 per stair.
blocks.detail: Those are Wills Flooring's published 2026 rates with a 500 sq ft minimum. Material is the other half of the bill and is quoted separately once you pick a floor, so a typical 1,000 sq ft Lynnwood main floor runs $3,250 in labor plus the wood.

blocks.html: Most people who call our showroom on 196th St SW ask the same thing: "What does hardwood cost per square foot, all in?" The honest answer is that nobody can give you one number until you pick the wood, because material can range from less than the labor to three times the labor. What we can do is publish the labor rate, explain exactly what it covers, and show you how the material tiers stack up so you can budget a Lynnwood project before we ever measure it.

blocks.text: What the installation labor rate covers

items.title: Engineered or solid
items.text: Nail-down, glue-down or floating installation of prefinished planks. Includes layout, cutting, rack-and-stagger, transitions at doorways and reinstalling baseboard shoe. You walk on it the same day.

items.title: Unfinished hardwood
items.text: Installing raw planks that get sanded and finished in place. Add our refinishing rates ($3.99 natural, $6.50 stained) for the sanding and three coats of Bona finish, so the true labor is $6.74 or more per sq ft.

items.title: Hardwood on stairs
items.text: Solid treads, risers and nosing fitted and fastened. Split-levels in Alderwood and Martha Lake usually have 13 to 14 stairs, which adds $1,625 to $1,750 to the job.

blocks.note: Prices from Wills Flooring's published price list. Flooring material, underlayment, old-floor removal and subfloor prep are quoted at the free in-home estimate.

blocks.text: The extras that show up on a Lynnwood invoice

items.title: Old floor removal
items.text: Carpet and pad come up fast. Glued vinyl, tile or an old glued-down hardwood take longer and generate disposal fees. We quote removal by the room after seeing what is down there.

items.title: Subfloor prep
items.text: Split-levels and ramblers from the 70s often have particleboard underlayment that must come out before nail-down hardwood, or dips that need leveling. This is the most common surprise, so we check it at the estimate.

items.title: Vapor barrier and underlayment
items.text: Over a crawlspace, which is most of Lynnwood, we lay a moisture retarder under nail-down floors. Floating engineered floors need a pad. Both are small line items but they are not in the labor rate.

items.title: Trim and transitions
items.text: New hardwood is thicker than the carpet it replaces, so doors get trimmed and thresholds change. Reducers to tile and shoe molding are included in labor; new baseboard is not.

blocks.text: Prefinished or unfinished: which saves money?

a.title: Pick prefinished when
items: You want the house back the same day
The floor is a single open area with no old hardwood to match
You are buying engineered wide plank
Budget matters more than a seamless custom look

b.title: Pick unfinished when
items: You are tying into original oak in another room
You want a custom stain color across the whole floor
You prefer a flat, filled surface with no bevels
You can be out of the house for four to five days

blocks.title: Check under the carpet first:
blocks.text: A large share of 1960s to 80s Lynnwood ramblers have solid oak under the carpet. Refinishing it costs $3.99 per sq ft all-in, which is usually less than new hardwood labor plus material. We look before we quote, and we will tell you if the cheaper job is the right one.
How to keep the quote honest

items.html: Get labor and material on separate lines. A single "per square foot installed" number hides which one is inflated. Ours are always split.
Ask what square footage is being billed. We bill the measured floor area, not the whole house, with a 500 sq ft minimum.
Ask about the wear layer. Two engineered floors can look identical in the box and differ by two refinishes over their life. Read more in our post on engineered vs solid hardwood.
Book in the off-season. Our Lynnwood install calendar is tightest from May through September. Winter installs are easier to schedule and the wood acclimates fine in a heated house.

Confirm the warranty and license. Wills Flooring is licensed and insured, has installed floors since 2013 and backs every install with a 1-year workmanship warranty. See the full price list before you compare.

faq.q: How much does it cost to install 1,000 sq ft of hardwood in Lynnwood?
faq.a: Labor is 1,000 × $3.25 = $3,250 for engineered or solid prefinished flooring at Wills Flooring's published rate. Add your material quote, which we give on the spot at the free estimate, plus any old-floor removal or subfloor prep the house needs.

faq.q: Is engineered hardwood cheaper to install than solid?
faq.a: The labor is the same, $3.25 per sq ft. The difference is in the material and the prep. Engineered can float or glue over a slab, while solid needs a wood subfloor and a vapor retarder over a crawlspace, which is most Lynnwood houses.

faq.q: Does the price include removing my carpet?
faq.a: No. Old-floor removal, disposal, underlayment and subfloor repairs are quoted separately at the estimate because they vary so much from house to house. Carpet and pad come up quickly; glued vinyl, tile or particleboard underlayment take longer and cost more to haul away.

faq.q: What is the 500 sq ft minimum?
faq.a: Any job under 500 sq ft is billed as 500 sq ft, so a 350 sq ft living room costs 500 × $3.25 = $1,625 in labor. Most Lynnwood customers add a hallway or dining room to use the minimum fully.

faq.q: How long does hardwood installation take in a Lynnwood house?
faq.a: A 1,000 sq ft prefinished install usually takes two to three working days including tear-out, and you can walk on it the same evening. Unfinished flooring adds three to four days of sanding and finishing. A full staircase adds roughly one more day.

faq.q: Can I buy the hardwood myself and just pay for labor?
faq.a: Yes, we install customer-supplied hardwood at the same $3.25 rate. We still inspect the boxes for moisture content and grade before installing, and the material warranty in that case comes from your supplier, not us.
